title: Diagnose a service startup failure
task: Use service.journal to find the wrong working directory. Write the correct path to diagnosis.txt and the corrected WorkingDirectory line to service-fix.conf.
hints: Read service.journal and identify the failing startup step.
Write the active path and the corrected directive to the two requested files.

checks.label: The diagnosis names the active release directory
The corrected unit directive points to the active release
checks.feedback: Write the full WorkingDirectory setting, including its key.

demo.explanation: CHDIR points to the startup directory.
Compare that path with the deployment record.
